data.title: A seat near the door

memoryNodes.cue: Lin wants to begin but needs time for reading.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林很想开始，不过阅读需要时间。

memoryNodes.cue: The class asks questions about a photograph.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 课堂围绕一张照片提出问题。

memoryNodes.cue: The group practises reading and writing.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 这个小组练习阅读与书写。

data.situation:
The next week, Lin chose a seat near the classroom door. She was eager to begin, but the shelves of books made her wonder how much she had forgotten. Two lecturers were arranging chairs at the front. One placed a small poster on the table: What counts as a useful question? Lin opened her notebook and left the first line blank. Lecturer: History is one discipline you can study here. Today we will use an old photograph to practise asking questions.
Lin: I'm eager to try, but I may need more time with the reading.
Lecturer: Tell me if you find it hard to keep up with the class. We can discuss the reading before the next session.
Lin: Thank you. I've been away from study for a while. The photograph was an intellectual challenge rather than a test of how many dates Lin knew. She had to ask who had taken it and what was outside the frame. An ambitious student beside her wanted to write a whole book about the street. Lin admired the idea, then wrote down one question of her own. On the wall, a poster for an adult literacy group showed the first letters of a name and a sentence from a bus notice. Reading and writing could open different doors for different people.

readingBlocks.en: The next week, Lin chose a seat near the classroom door. She was eager to begin, but the shelves of books made her wonder how much she had forgotten. Two lecturers were arranging chairs at the front. One placed a small poster on the table: What counts as a useful question? Lin opened her notebook and left the first line blank.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一周，林在教室门边选了一个座位。她热切地想开始，但满架的书让她担心自己忘了多少东西。两位大学讲师正在前面摆椅子。一位在桌上放了一张小海报：怎样的问题才有用？林打开笔记本，把第一行留空。

readingBlocks.en:
Lecturer: History is one discipline you can study here. Today we will use an old photograph to practise asking questions.
Lin: I'm eager to try, but I may need more time with the reading.
Lecturer: Tell me if you find it hard to keep up with the class. We can discuss the reading before the next session.
Lin: Thank you. I've been away from study for a while.
readingBlocks.zh:
讲师：历史是你在这里可以学习的一门学科。今天我们用一张旧照片练习提问。
林：我很想试试，不过阅读部分可能需要多一点时间。
讲师：如果你觉得难以跟上课堂，请告诉我。下一堂课前我们可以谈谈阅读材料。
林：谢谢。我有一段时间没有学习了。

readingBlocks.en: The photograph was an intellectual challenge rather than a test of how many dates Lin knew. She had to ask who had taken it and what was outside the frame. An ambitious student beside her wanted to write a whole book about the street. Lin admired the idea, then wrote down one question of her own. On the wall, a poster for an adult literacy group showed the first letters of a name and a sentence from a bus notice. Reading and writing could open different doors for different people.
readingBlocks.zh: 这张照片带来了思考上的挑战，而不是考林记得多少日期。她需要问是谁拍的、画框外还有什么。身旁一位志向远大的学生想写一本关于这条街的书。林欣赏这个想法，然后记下了自己的一个问题。墙上成人读写小组的海报，展示了姓名的首字母和公交告示里的一句话。对不同的人，读与写能打开不同的门。

glossary.note: lecturer是大学或学院授课人员；lecturers为复数。
glossary.example: Two lecturers are arranging chairs before the class.
glossary.exampleZh: 两位大学讲师在上课前摆椅子。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · lecturer
externalEvidence.findingZh: 大学或学院授课人员的用法，尤其见于英国；原复数仅属词形变化。

glossary.note: 名词表示学术领域；与纪律、处罚等用法分开。
glossary.example: History is one discipline taught at the university.
glossary.exampleZh: 历史是这所大学教授的一门学科。

glossary.zh: 需要运用理解与思考能力的；智力上的
glossary.note: 形容词修饰challenge，强调思考与理解；不是称呼知识分子的名词。
glossary.example: The photograph presents an intellectual challenge.
glossary.exampleZh: 这张照片带来了一项思考上的挑战。

externalEvidence.definition: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind

glossary.note: be eager to do something；表达强烈的意愿。
glossary.example: Lin is eager to begin the course.

externalEvidence.definition: having or showing keen interest or intense desire or impatient expectancy

glossary.note: 形容人有抱负、渴望成功；可用be ambitious或an ambitious student。
glossary.example: An ambitious student hopes to write a book about the street.
glossary.exampleZh: 一位有抱负的学生希望写一本关于这条街的书。

externalEvidence.definition: having a strong desire for success or achievement

glossary.note: 本句基本读写能力；与digital literacy的数字技术运用能力区分。
glossary.example: The adult literacy group practises reading and writing.
glossary.exampleZh: 成人读写小组练习阅读与书写。

externalEvidence.definition: the ability to read and write

glossary.zh: 跟上；保持与……同样的进度
glossary.note: keep up with + 人或课程等；本句为学习进度，不是只保持距离。
glossary.example: Tell me if you find it hard to keep up with the class.
glossary.exampleZh: 如果你觉得难以跟上课堂进度，请告诉我。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · keep-up
externalEvidence.findingZh: keep up with表示以同样速度或进度前进，区别保持联系和了解新闻。
